title: Unit Event — Cast a Spell on You — Episode7 Make Me an Idol

meta.Event Outline: Having held their real-life event, Shizuku and the others feel that their bond with their fans has grown even stronger. While exploring ideas with their fans, one of them suggests making MORE MORE JUMP! stage outfits as their next endeavor!

rows.Line: A few weeks later
Cheerful * Days Theater - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good morning.
I'm looking forward to another wonderful day!

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Morning, Shizuku!
Let's start by getting changed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's make today another good one, my Enchantress.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Enchantress?
You gave your outfit a name, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I know it's strange.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But whenever I wear this, I feel like I can become someone entirely different.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's an outfit that has the power to transform Shizuku, plain and simple, into an idol that really shines... Like an enchantress.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now I see.
It is a bit strange, but I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: We'll be wearing new outfits for our next song, so we might get to see a totally different side of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
New outfits...?
Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's unfortunate that I have to say goodbye to this one, but I'm looking forward to what our new outfits can do for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That went so well!

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Great show, Shizuku!
You were amazing on stage today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm glad that all of our fans enjoyed everything so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
I was able to do everything without letting my nerves get in the way. I have my outfit to thank for that.)

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: We'll start working on our new song tomorrow, so let's keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! I'll be looking forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku.
Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I just received an offer for you about some work. If you don't mind, I'd like to discuss that with you now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An offer for me...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes, they seemed very eager to have you after seeing you perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... Isn't this offer more appropriate for a more senior member...?

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: You need to take these opportunities whenever they come your way, Shizuku! At the same time, you'll still need to practice our new song as we normally do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They're making this offer because of how I performed on stage...? I don't know what to say...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It must be because of you.
Thank you, Enchantress.
Shoot Location

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm Shizuku Hinomori. Thank you for having me today!

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming, Ms. Hinomori!
I'll start by showing you what you'll be wearing today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I never thought that I'd end up working as a model like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I'm not sure if I'm suited for this...
But I have to do my best as a member of Cheerful * Days!)

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line: First, this one-piece...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so lovely...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's simple but so elegant and mature!
The little frills are a cute touch too...!

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
This is sort of based on Cinderella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Cinderella...?

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure you're familiar with the scene where her fairy godmother turns her rags into a beautiful ball gown.

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line: I made this dress so that a girl can become someone different just by wearing it. A chance to become someone special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's such a wonderful theme...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My stage outfit does the same thing for me. It's like someone's casting a spell on me whenever I put it on.

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line: Wait, Hinomori, you too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. To tell you the truth, I wasn't all that confident about being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my stage outfit allowed me to become someone other than my usual self...

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line:
I see.
If that's the case, your outfit may actually be enchanted, Ms. Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Designer
rows.Line: With a kind spell that turns you into an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A kind spell...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You may be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to do my best during the shoot. I promise to show everybody just how wonderful this dress really is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also want other girls to experience the beautiful magic that's been imbued in this dress...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A kind spell that turns me into an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Quite a lot happened after that and I became so entrenched in other things that I couldn't even put any thought into my stage outfits.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Back then, that outfit was really my saving grace in terms of being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There must be a way for me to cast a spell like that on MORE MORE JUMP!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do we all have our designs ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same here!
But it wasn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your design was already that good before, so I can't wait to see how it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The same goes for your designs as well, Minori, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I take it that you figured things out?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I finally found the design I was looking for.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've never actually designed an outfit like this before, so I'm not confident about how it looks aesthetically...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you really did figure out what “you want to convey”, then I'm sure it turned out great.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, this is my first time too, so I had a feeling that you were thinking the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. I'm really looking forward to seeing your design, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
You used to be a model too, so I have to think you have a talent for this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I believe it's about time we started.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make sure our stream puts a smile on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, you guys!
It's time for another MORE MORE JUMP! stream!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Finally!>
<I live for this!>
<Ready and watching!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all for joining us again today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember how we talked about having a little design competition for our stage outfits during our stream the other day?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I remember!>
<Did you guys design something?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think we've all come up with something very nice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it really wasn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I daydreamed a lot about what I've always wanted to wear if I ever became an idol and thought I'd get some ideas really fast, but I couldn't think of anything good.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Fan first, idol second.>
<One of Minori's best qualities.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did come up with page after page of designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you have such a vivid imagination.
Compared to me who only just figured out a design yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As much as you struggled, Shizuku, I'm sure you managed to come up with something really good! I can't wait to see yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I'm sure we're all excited since none of us have seen any of our final designs.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Really?!>
<Let's see the rejects too!>
<Show us! Hurry!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Seems like they're just as excited.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, let the games begin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ready, everyone! One, two...

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: “MMJ's Stage Outfit Design Competition☆”
song00004_off_f
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's start by explaining the rules.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us will be presenting a design for a stage outfit that we want to wear as MORE MORE JUMP! Once we've presented our designs, you'll get to vote for your favorite one.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Cool!>
<I can't wait.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our first presenter will be... Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Everyone, I hope you're ready!
